verdict.rationale: Context.dev lets you set up monitors that watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and emit signed change events [context-dev-docs-9]. That is a form of event-triggered automation. However, the evidence shows only event delivery: there is no rule-builder or conditional logic that runs actions automatically, so the user has to build the downstream actions themselves. Missing for 10: user-defined trigger conditions/rules, built-in action execution (e.g. auto-run scrape/extract on change), documentation of rule configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
